description:
The callable inventory has no guard that every entry is JUSTIFIED. A `CallableId`
that matches no upstream flow at all would be caught by nothing.

## Verified at main 417c5b0b5

The deletion this records is real:

    $ grep -rn "assert_no_unreachable_callable_facts" src/ runtime/ tests/  -> nothing
    $ grep -rn "collect_callable_shapes"              src/ runtime/ tests/  -> nothing

The inventory it wants guarded is real and still there: `CallableFacts` /
`pub callable_facts: HashMap<CallableId, CallableFacts>` at
src/compiler2/artifact.rs:35,73.

## The property is genuinely untested

Every assertion touching `callable_facts` in transport_contract_test.rs runs
FLOW -> CALLABLE (completeness), never the reverse:

    :4855  assert_callable_facts_match_upstream_flow  -- handed a callable you
           already selected, checks its resolutions project the upstream flow
    :4873  asserts boundary_ids.len() <= first_class_surfaces.len()
           assert_boundary_resolutions_match_upstream_flow panics with
           "boundary {boundary:?} should have upstream first-class edge evidence"
    :4300  assert_eq!(matching_callables.len(), 1, ...) -- partial injectivity

NONE of them iterates the inventory and asserts every entry is justified.
`grep -rn "unjustified|orphan|unreachable_callable"` across the test files
returns only an unrelated quoted_surface_test.rs hit about `@spec`.

## The three justification paths all still exist

- structural `ShapeDescr::Callable` (native.rs:4161 `shape_contains_callable`)
- boundary callables (`BoundaryFacts` / `boundary_ids`)
- the arrow-typed lane path

The fixture pair wanted for the third is live:
`compiler2_transport_plan_preserves_enumerable_suspend_continuation_captures`
(transport_contract_test.rs:1462) with `assert_suspend_continuation_captures` at
:1596.

## Caveat

This does not claim the inventory currently HOLDS a garbage entry -- and neither
did the original. It claims the guard is missing, which is true. Coverage debt,
correctly framed.

Verified accurate as filed; nothing in it was stale. fz-go4.18.9, cited as the
origin of the audit, is closed.
title: No test guards against unreachable or unjustified callable facts in the product inventory
